claims.claim: 糠酸莫米松鼻喷剂对季节性变应性鼻炎与常年性变应性鼻炎鼻部症状的治疗和（或）预防疗效已充分确立，按牛津循证医学中心分级为 Ia 级。
claims.sourceTitle: Mometasone furoate nasal spray: a systematic review
claims.supportQuote: MF usage for treatment and/or prophylaxis of the nasal symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis and perennial allergic rhinitis has been fully established and a level of evidence Ia (Centre for Evidence Based Medicine, Oxford 2009) has been provided
claims.applicability: 适用于过敏性鼻炎的鼻部症状控制；该分级是对疗效方向与确定性的总结，未给出单一效应量。
claims.uncertainty: 证据等级 Ia 来自纳入的系统综述与随机对照试验，但原文为叙述性综述，未提供合并效应量。

claims.claim: 鼻用糖皮质激素被认为是中重度变应性鼻炎最有效的药物治疗，对鼻部与眼部症状均有效并改善生活质量。
claims.sourceTitle: Pharmacology, particle deposition and drug administration techniques of intranasal corticosteroids for treating allergic rhinitis
claims.supportQuote: INCs are considered to be the most effective therapy for moderate‐to‐severe AR, as they are effective against nasal and ocular symptoms and improve quality of life.
claims.applicability: 适用于中重度变应性鼻炎的症状控制。
claims.uncertainty: 此为综述层面的总体判断，未附单一数值效应量。

claims.claim: 纳入多项随机对照试验（共 704 例）的 Meta 分析显示，糠酸莫米松较安慰剂显著改善预计 FEV1（MD 7.53 个百分点；95% CI 7.02–8.04）、FEV1（MD 0.11 L；95% CI 0.10–0.12）与清晨呼气峰流速（MD 17.70 L/min；95% CI 9.91–25.49）。
claims.sourceTitle: The efficacy of mometasone furoate for children with asthma: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
claims.supportQuote: mometasone furoate is associated with substantially increased predicted forced expiratory volume in 1 s (FEV 1 ) (mean difference (MD) = 7.53; 95% CI: 7.02–8.04; p < 0.00001), FEV 1 (MD = 0.11; 95% CI: 0.10–0.12; p < 0.00001), and morning peak expiratory flow (AM PEF) (MD = 17.70; 95% CI: 9.91–25.49; p < 0.00001) … sample sizes ranged from 89 to 225 with a total of 704.
claims.applicability: 适用于4–11岁持续性哮喘患儿的肺功能改善。
claims.uncertainty: 基于4项随机对照试验共704例，样本量与剂型异质性限制外推。

claims.claim: 儿童哮喘中糠酸莫米松未显著增加咽炎（RR 0.96；95% CI 0.59–1.58）、上呼吸道感染（RR 0.73；95% CI 0.50–1.05）与总不良事件（RR 1.05；95% CI 0.84–1.31）。
claims.sourceTitle: The efficacy of mometasone furoate for children with asthma: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
claims.supportQuote: but demonstrates no obvious effect on pharyngitis (RR = 0.96; 95% CI: 0.59–1.58; p = 0.89), upper respiratory tract infections (RR = 0.73; 95% CI: 0.50–1.05; p = 0.09), or adverse events (RR = 1.05; 95% CI: 0.84–1.31; p = 0.69)
claims.applicability: 适用于儿童哮喘短期至中期安全性。
claims.uncertainty: 纳入试验随访期有限，长期安全性证据不足。

claims.claim: QUARTZ 试验（1519 例）显示，QMF149（茚达特罗 500 µg/糠酸莫米松 400 µg）较单用糠酸莫米松 400 µg 显著降低需全身糖皮质激素治疗的急性发作年化率（率比 0.71；95% CI 0.55 to 0.90；p=0.005）。
claims.sourceTitle: Effect of once-daily indacaterol maleate/mometasone furoate on exacerbation risk in adolescent and adult asthma: a double-blind randomised controlled trial
claims.supportQuote: 1519 adolescents and adults with persistent asthma who were treated or qualified for treatment with combination LABA/ICS were randomised, and 1508 were included in the intention-to-treat analysis. … Patients were randomised to QMF149 (indacaterol maleate 500 µg/MF 400 µg) or MF (400 µg) once daily … QMF149 significantly reduced the annual rate of exacerbations requiring systemic corticosteroids (rate ratio=0.71; 95% CI 0.55 to 0.90, p=0.005).
claims.applicability: 适用于接受或符合 ICS/LABA 联合治疗的青少年与成人持续性哮喘。
claims.uncertainty: 主要终点为安全性终点，该效应为关键次要终点。

claims.claim: QUARTZ 试验主要终点（首次严重急性发作时间）在 QMF149 与单用糠酸莫米松组间无显著差异（HR 0.31；95% CI 0.06 to 1.54；p=0.151），两组严重发作事件均少（2 例对 6 例）。
claims.sourceTitle: Effect of once-daily indacaterol maleate/mometasone furoate on exacerbation risk in adolescent and adult asthma: a double-blind randomised controlled trial
claims.supportQuote: Treatment with QMF149 resulted in no significant difference in time to first serious exacerbation compared to MF (2 (0.3%) vs 6 events (0.8%); difference −0.52 percentage point; 95% CI −1.25 to 0.21, p=0.160, HR=0.31; 95% CI 0.06 to 1.54, p=0.151).
claims.applicability: 适用于评估加用茚达特罗不增加严重哮喘发作风险。
claims.uncertainty: 事件率低致检验把握度不足，宽置信区间。

claims.claim: IRIDIUM 试验（3092 例）显示，中剂量 MF–IND–GLY 与高剂量 MF–IND–GLY 在第 26 周较相应剂量 MF–IND 的 trough FEV1 改善分别为 76 mL（95% CI 41–111）与 65 mL（31–99），较氟替卡松–沙美特罗改善 99 mL（64–133）与 119 mL（85–154）。
claims.sourceTitle: Once-daily, single-inhaler mometasone-indacaterol-glycopyrronium versus mometasone-indacaterol or twice-daily fluticasone-salmeterol in patients with inadequately controlled asthma (IRIDIUM)
claims.supportQuote:
3092 of 4851 patients screened were randomly assigned … Medium-dose MF–IND–GLY (treatment 
difference [Δ] 76 mL [95% CI 41–111]; p<0·001) and high-dose MF–IND–GLY (Δ 65 mL [31–99]; p<0·001) 
showed superior improvement in trough FEV
1 versus corresponding doses of MF–IND at week 26. 
Improvements in trough FEV 1 were greater for both medium-dose MF–IND–GLY (99 mL [64–133]; p<0·001) 
and high-dose MF–IND–GLY (119 mL [85–154]; p<0·001) than for high-dose FLU–SAL at week 26.
claims.applicability: 适用于经中高剂量 ICS/LABA 仍未控制的成人哮喘。
claims.uncertainty: 52周双盲研究，肺功能为主要终点。

claims.claim: 鼻用糖皮质激素是伴或不伴鼻息肉慢性鼻窦炎内科治疗的基石，局部起效以减轻黏膜炎症与症状。
claims.sourceTitle: The Efficacy and Safety of Intranasal Corticosteroids in Chronic Rhinosinusitis: A Systematic Review
claims.supportQuote: Intranasal corticosteroids (INCS) are the cornerstone of medical management in both CRSwNP and CRSsNP, acting locally to reduce mucosal inflammation and alleviate symptoms.
claims.applicability: 适用于成人及儿童慢性鼻窦炎的一线药物治疗。
claims.uncertainty: 为系统综述的总体结论，未做定量合并。

claims.claim: 在儿童慢性鼻窦炎中，糠酸莫米松联合盐水雾化使 SN-5 评分下降 −0.58（p=0.009）。
claims.sourceTitle: The Efficacy and Safety of Intranasal Corticosteroids in Chronic Rhinosinusitis: A Systematic Review
claims.supportQuote: mometasone plus saline reduced SN-5 by −0.58 (p=0.009)
claims.applicability: 适用于幼儿慢性鼻窦炎的生活质量改善。
claims.uncertainty: 仅来自一项儿科随机对照试验（Latek 等），样本量较小。

claims.claim: 对复发性鼻息肉患者，糠酸莫米松鼻窦植入物联合 MF 鼻喷剂在第90天使仍需再次内镜鼻窦手术者比例下降 59%（自基线100%降至41%），单用 MF 鼻喷剂对照组下降 31%（自100%降至69%）。
claims.sourceTitle: In-office Placement of Mometasone Furoate Sinus Implants for Recurrent Nasal Polyps: A Pooled Analysis
claims.supportQuote: 59% reduction in the proportion of patients indicated for RESS at day 90 (from 100% at the onset to 41%), compared to 31% reduction (from 100% to 69%) among control patients.
claims.applicability: 适用于既往内镜鼻窦术后复发的鼻息肉患者。
claims.uncertainty: 汇总两项随机对照试验；对照组仍需长期 MF 鼻喷剂。

claims.claim: 常用鼻用糖皮质激素（含糠酸莫米松、丙酸氟替卡松、糠酸氟替卡松、环索奈德）的全身生物利用度均<1%。
claims.sourceTitle: Pharmacology, particle deposition and drug administration techniques of intranasal corticosteroids for treating allergic rhinitis
claims.supportQuote: Commonly used INCs (e.g. mometasone furoate, fluticasone propionate, fluticasone furoate and ciclesonide) have pharmacokinetic properties that minimize systemic bioavailability (<1%) compared with other INCs (e.g. triamcinolone acetonide, flunisolide, beclomethasone and dexamethasone) and oral corticosteroids.
claims.applicability: 适用于鼻用剂型全身暴露评估。
claims.uncertainty: <1% 为群体平均值，个体与联用 CYP3A4 抑制剂时可更高。

claims.claim: 鼻用糖皮质激素亲脂性排序（由高到低）为糠酸莫米松、丙酸氟替卡松、二丙酸倍氯米松、布地奈德、曲安奈德与氟尼缩松。
claims.sourceTitle: Pharmacology, particle deposition and drug administration techniques of intranasal corticosteroids for treating allergic rhinitis
claims.supportQuote: The ranked order of INCs, from highest to lowest lipid solubility, is mometasone furoate, fluticasone propionate, beclomethasone dipropionate, budesonide, triamcinolone acetonide and flunisolide.
claims.applicability: 用于比较不同鼻用激素的理化特性。
claims.uncertainty: 亲脂性与临床结局差异的关系尚不明确。

claims.claim: 鼻用糖皮质激素未显著增加眼压升高（RR 2.24；95% CI 0.68–7.34）或白内障风险（绝对增加 0.02%；95% CI −0.3% to 0.4%），但与青光眼风险的关联尚不能排除。
claims.sourceTitle: Pharmacology, particle deposition and drug administration techniques of intranasal corticosteroids for treating allergic rhinitis
claims.supportQuote: INCs are not associated with a significant increased risk of elevating the intraocular pressure (relative risk 2.24 [95% CI: 0.68–7.34, 494 studies]) or developing cataracts (absolute increased incidence 0.02% [95% CI: −0.3% to 0.4%, 494 studies]). An association with the risk of occurrence of glaucoma cannot be ruled out.
claims.applicability: 适用于鼻用糖皮质激素长期使用的眼部安全性。
claims.uncertainty: 多数纳入研究随访期最长1年，长期数据缺乏。

claims.claim: 关于鼻用糖皮质激素对儿童生长的影响，多项随机对照试验结论不一：部分研究未见显著变化，部分研究见短期生长速度的暂时性降低。
claims.sourceTitle: Pharmacology, particle deposition and drug administration techniques of intranasal corticosteroids for treating allergic rhinitis
claims.supportQuote: several RCTs have studied the effects of INCs on the growth of children (i.e. aged 3 or older) and demonstrated contrasting results. 32 , 35 , 36 , 37 In some studies, no significant changes were found, but a temporary reduction in short‐time growth velocity was evident.
claims.applicability: 适用于3岁及以上儿童长期使用。
claims.uncertainty: 证据不一致，长期生长结局数据缺乏。

claims.claim: 不同给药途径的糖皮质激素所致肾上腺功能不全风险不同：关节内、口服与多途径联用风险较高（约50%），而局部或鼻内途径风险较低（约5%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Glucocorticoid treatment and adrenal suppression in children: current view and open issues
claims.supportQuote: intra-articular, oral, and multiple formulations are associated with the higher risk (about 50%), while topical or intranasal routes may result in a lower risk (about 5%)
claims.applicability: 适用于评估糠酸莫米松鼻用/吸入途径的系统性风险。
claims.uncertainty: 为综述引用的估计值，非糠酸莫米松专属的前瞻性发生率。

claims.claim: 所有局部糖皮质激素（吸入、鼻内、关节内、经皮）均有可测的体循环生物利用度并对 HPA 轴有可重复的抑制作用，尤其是高效价、长半衰期药物。
claims.sourceTitle: Glucocorticoid treatment and adrenal suppression in children: current view and open issues
claims.supportQuote: all types of topical GCs (inhaled, intranasal, intra-articular, transcutaneous) have a significant bioavailability in the systemic circulation, with reproducible suppressive effects on the HPA axis, especially when compounds with higher potency and long half-life are used
claims.applicability: 适用于提示鼻用激素并非完全无系统性作用。
claims.uncertainty: 方向明确，但各药程度不同，需个体化评估。

claims.claim: 糠酸莫米松鼻喷剂成人剂量为每侧鼻孔2喷、每日一次（每喷50 µg），儿童剂量减半为每侧鼻孔1喷、每日一次。
claims.sourceTitle: Mometasone furoate nasal spray: a systematic review
claims.supportQuote: Its dosage is 2 sprays/nostril once a day (50 mcg in each spray) and the dosage for children is halved to 1 spray for each nostril daily.
claims.applicability: 适用于过敏性鼻炎的常规剂量参考。
claims.uncertainty: 不同监管辖区与适应证剂量可能存在差异。

claims.claim: 局部鼻用糖皮质激素被认为是中重度过敏性鼻炎抗炎治疗的一线药物。
claims.sourceTitle: Mometasone furoate in the treatment of mild, moderate, or severe persistent allergic rhinitis: a non-inferiority study (PUMA)
claims.supportQuote: The latter are recognized as the first-choice drugs in anti-inflammatory treatment of moderate to severe allergic diseases.
claims.applicability: 适用于中重度过敏性鼻炎的用药选择。
claims.uncertainty: 来自随机试验背景陈述，非该文主要结果。

claims.claim: 按推荐剂量使用时，糠酸莫米松的系统性不良反应少见，主要不良反应为局部（鼻部刺激、鼻出血），这一结论来自儿童哮喘不良事件无显著增加、鼻内途径肾上腺抑制风险约5%、全身生物利用度<1%三条独立证据。
claims.applicability: 适用于按推荐剂量短期至中期使用；不覆盖高剂量、长疗程或联用CYP3A4抑制剂的个体。
claims.uncertainty: 三条证据的设计与人群不同（儿童哮喘RCT汇总、内分泌综述、药理综述），未做跨设计定量合并，属中确定性。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: The efficacy of mometasone furoate for children with asthma: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
supportingSources.supportQuote: but demonstrates no obvious effect on pharyngitis (RR = 0.96; 95% CI: 0.59–1.58; p = 0.89), upper respiratory tract infections (RR = 0.73; 95% CI: 0.50–1.05; p = 0.09), or adverse events (RR = 1.05; 95% CI: 0.84–1.31; p = 0.69)

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Glucocorticoid treatment and adrenal suppression in children: current view and open issues
supportingSources.supportQuote: intra-articular, oral, and multiple formulations are associated with the higher risk (about 50%), while topical or intranasal routes may result in a lower risk (about 5%)

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Pharmacology, particle deposition and drug administration techniques of intranasal corticosteroids for treating allergic rhinitis
supportingSources.supportQuote: Commonly used INCs (e.g. mometasone furoate, fluticasone propionate, fluticasone furoate and ciclesonide) have pharmacokinetic properties that minimize systemic bioavailability (<1%) compared with other INCs (e.g. triamcinolone acetonide, flunisolide, beclomethasone and dexamethasone) and oral corticosteroids.

claims.claim: 按成人标准剂量（每侧鼻孔2喷×每喷50 µg，即200 µg/日）与<1%的全身生物利用度计，糠酸莫米松鼻喷剂的每日全身暴露量低于2 µg/日。
claims.method: 成人标准剂量为每侧鼻孔2喷、每日一次，每喷50 µg，即4×50 µg=200 µg/日；以全身生物利用度<1%为上限，200 µg×0.01=2 µg/日，故全身暴露<2 µg/日。
claims.assumptions: 以<1%作为生物利用度上限；经鼻吸收与吞咽后首过代谢的净全身暴露通常更低。
claims.sensitivity: 若实际生物利用度接近1%上限，则全身暴露接近2 µg/日；若低于0.1%，则<0.2 µg/日；联用CYP3A4抑制剂时该上界不成立。
claims.applicability: 仅用于说明鼻喷剂标准剂量下全身暴露的量级，不构成安全阈值结论。
claims.uncertainty: 生物利用度与清除率为群体估计，个体变异未纳入。

claims.claim: 临床研究中不同鼻用糖皮质激素在治疗变应性鼻炎方面总体未显示具有临床重要意义的差异，且局部效能（topical potency）与临床反应相关性差；但在较重度变应性鼻炎患者中缺乏头对头比较研究。
claims.sourceTitle: Intranasal Corticosteroids: Topical Potency, Systemic Activity and Therapeutic Index
claims.supportQuote: Despite differences in topical potency, physicochemical and pharmacokinetic properties between INCSs, clinical studies of INCSs in the treatment of AR generally show no clinically important differences between these compounds, and poor correlation between INCS topical potency and clinical response. However, the lack of head-to-head comparisons of INCSs in clinical studies conducted in more severe AR patients should be noted.
claims.applicability: 用于比较不同鼻用糖皮质激素的疗效与安全性差异。
claims.uncertainty: 为叙述性综述的总体判断；头对头研究缺乏，差异可能未充分显现。
